description: Switching handlers (ADR 0023): engine/ChangeRadar.Handlers.psm1 Get-HandlerPlan, used by setup/Set-Handlers.ps1. Written before the engine function. A handler is on when its flow is on and its subscriptions are enabled; the plan switches both together. A handler's name comes from its flow name 'Change Radar handler: <name>'. Names compare without case. Errors stop the whole plan: an unknown name, a handler whose flow isn't installed (Handlers solution not imported), or the same name in -On and -Off. Steps are listed flows first, then subscriptions, each in name order; anything already in the wanted state is 'unchanged' and isn't a step.

subscriptions.name: High or Critical rating to Teams

cases.note: turn on Teams cards and the digest from a fresh import

steps: subscription High or Critical rating to Teams enable
subscription Incident opened to Teams enable
subscription New signals in the digest enable
subscription High or Critical rating to Teams enable
subscription Incident opened to Teams enable

subscriptionsEnabled: High or Critical rating to Teams

cases.note: half on (flow on, subscriptions off, as an old install had them): completes it

steps: subscription High or Critical rating to Teams enable
subscription Incident opened to Teams enable

cases.note: turn off: flow and subscriptions together

subscriptionsEnabled: High or Critical rating to Teams

steps: subscription High or Critical rating to Teams disable
subscription Incident opened to Teams disable

cases.note: the template has no subscriptions: only its flow switches
